static_spy_qqq_50_50_control.mechanism: Static 50% SPY / 50% QQQ; ineligible to become the agentic champion

qqq_vs_spy_relative_regime_fully_investe.mechanism: Every five sessions choose QQQ only when it has stronger 63/126/252 BIL-excess momentum than SPY and is above SMA200; otherwise SPY

spy_core_qqq_sector_12_6.mechanism: 50% SPY, 25% QQQ, and 25% divided among the top three sectors by 12-minus-6 momentum

qqq_core_sector_12_6.mechanism: 50% QQQ and 50% divided among the top three sectors by 12-minus-6 momentum

qqq_defensive_dual_momentum.mechanism: Monthly QQQ when its 252-session BIL-excess momentum is positive; otherwise strongest positive IEF/TLT/GLD or BIL

qqq_regime_defensive_rotation.mechanism: Five-session QQQ SMA200/63d risk-on rule; otherwise strongest positive IEF/TLT/GLD by 126/252 BIL-excess momentum or BIL

equity_defensive_relative_strength.mechanism: Monthly strongest positive QQQ/SPY/IWM/IEF/TLT/GLD by mean 63/126/252 BIL-excess momentum or BIL

spy_qqq_defensive_sleeves.mechanism: When QQQ is risk-on hold 50% SPY/50% QQQ; otherwise retain 50% SPY and place the other half in the strongest positive TLT/GLD/IEF or BIL
